channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Heisley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Heisley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Michael Heisley
item.description:
“I send my prayers out to the family. Mike Heisley has been good to me. It’s sad to see this happen and for him to be in this situation. We’ll continue to pray for him and wish him a speedy recovery.”

Lionel Hollins on Michael Heisley, Feb 24, 2013. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Zach Randolph on Michael Heisley
item.description:
forward Zach Randolph said.

“As long as he's going to be an owner that's into it and cares about it with a passion then it'll be a good thing. I like Mr. Heisley, so I definitely care about who owns it.”

Zach Randolph on Michael Heisley, Jun 18, 2012. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Jerry West on Michael Heisley
item.description:
“Mike (Heisley) and I certainly had our share of 'spirited discussions' about what needed to happen for the team to go much further than just getting into the playoffs but at no time did I ever feel he wasn't behind me.”

Jerry West on Michael Heisley, Oct 20, 2011. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: David Stern on Michael Heisley
item.description:
Stern also praised the Grizzlies for their charitable contributions to the city.

“We’re extremely proud to have Michael Heisley as an owner and that the team continues to make a contribution in the community under his leadership,”

David Stern on Michael Heisley, Dec 15, 2010. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.
